Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.command

Class TelemetryInvoker

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.command.TelemetryInvoker
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommandQueue, Runnable
public class TelemetryInvoker extends Object implements CommandQueue, Runnable
The invoker of the Command pattern. It keeps a thread-safe queue of commands and runs them one at a time, in order, on a single background thread, so BlueJ's screen thread never waits.
Author:
Anushka Dwarika
